problem: ICM binds at 78-86, CRBN docks at 112-128 (96° away). ICM-PROTAC has 0.2% pass rate.

solutions.name: A1_4COOH as Molecular Glue (test FIRST - cheapest)
solutions.mechanism: Improved ICM analog (COOH, -11.22) may recruit an E3 ligase directly at the 78-86 site. HMGB2 has 40 lysines, all accessible. Basic surface recruits acidic E3 surfaces.
solutions.experiment: Treat cells with A1_4COOH (0.1-10 μM) → WB for HMGB2 at 24h → ± MG132 ± CRBN KO ± proteasome inhibitors
solutions.success_criteria: HMGB2 drops >50% at ≤10 μM, rescued by MG132

solutions.name: Dual/Bivalent Warhead: A1_4COOH + Box B binder (glycyrrhizin)
solutions.mechanism: Link A1_4COOH (binds 78-86) to glycyrrhizin (binds Box B 112-128). The bivalent molecule sits ACROSS the CRBN interface, positioning an exit vector directly at CRBN.
solutions.experiment: Design bivalent (computational) → synthesize → P4ward test → cellular degradation

solutions.name: Alternative E3 ligase for ICM site
solutions.mechanism: Instead of CRBN (docks 96° away), screen DCAF1/RNF114/β-TrCP - if any docks at 78-86, the ICM-PROTAC becomes viable.
solutions.experiment: MegaDock screen of ICM-HMGB2 against DCAF1, RNF114, FEM1B, β-TrCP surfaces → check if any docks at 78-86
solutions.success_criteria: Any E3 docks within 20 Å of ICM site

solutions.name: HMGB2 destabilization via DNA-binding disruption (H4)
solutions.mechanism: ICM blocks HMGB2-DNA binding → free HMGB2 is unstable → proteasomal degradation. A1_4COOH (stronger binder) may be more effective than ICM.
solutions.experiment: EMSA (ICM blocks HMGB2-DNA complex) → measure free HMGB2 half-life in cells

solutions.name: Degron-tag approach (definitive, not ICM-based)
solutions.mechanism: Fuse HMGB2 with dTAG or Auxin degron → inducible degradation. NOT using ICM, but guarantees degradation if the goal is HMGB2 loss.
solutions.experiment: CRISPR knock-in of degron tag → add degrader → HMGB2 loss

recommendation: Run S1 (A1_4COOH glue test) + S3 (alt E3 screen) in parallel first. They are cheap and fast. If S1 works: optimized ICM alone degrades HMGB2 = SUCCESS. If S3 finds a compatible E3: ICM-PROTAC becomes viable with the right E3. S2 (bivalent) if both fail.
